correctness.rationale: For a=min(m,n) and b=qa+r, positive column degrees lie in 1..a; equal-degree column pairs contribute zero. Convexity of choose(c_d,2) forces minimum ties T=(a-r)choose(q,2)+r choose(q+1,2), bounding NODF≤1-T/K. Ferrers initial-segment columns with all c_d=q or q+1 attain every available nontied pair contribution, and equality forces a strictly nested row chain, hence Ferrers and balanced degree multiplicities. Choices of r degree labels give exactly choose(a,r) classes; fixed-a asymptotics 1-1/a. Independent exhaustive bitmatrix enumeration checked (2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(2,5),(3,3),(3,4),(3,5): 18,859 valid labeled matrices, maxima and types agree.
